propositions: Test `test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials` deterministically fails 0/3 with signature `calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11]` because the test oracle measures executed filesystem calls but the enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence responses.

Commit e1352535ace changed the policy to allow batched evidence calls to execute instead of being suppressed, decoupling the oracle's measurement unit (executed calls) from the enforcement unit (evidence responses).
The production banking behavior is correct and intended; the test oracle is the defective artifact that must be re-denominated to measure evidence responses instead of executed calls.

Re-denominating the oracle to evidence-response units preserves the original safety intent (incremental banking with bounded gaps, no zero-bank exhaustion) while accepting the intended batched execution from dd41.

The fix moves response-counting infrastructure and the bounded-gap oracle to `tests/_bank_observer.py` and adds a new unit regression in `tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py` to validate the re-scoped contract against stub transcripts.
